memories.text: Appointment booked for initial hypertension review with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) on 2025-04-15 at 10:00 am.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs; works as a lab technician; walks to bus stop without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal); no cognitive concerns.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds; fall risk normal.
medicines: 4 regular: amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD.
mood: Reports good mood; denies anxiety or depressive symptoms.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Lakshmi Kulkarni, provides occasional support.
goals: "I want to stay healthy and continue my job without medication side effects."
